labels.look: Yellow field, white newspaper pages with condensed Etna headlines over serif body text, sticky 'ETNA' nav bar, large intro paragraph below
labels.ux: Three carousels of front pages with prev/next arrows; 'Read more' link
labels.learn: Period-appropriate fake news (1871 Paris dispatches) gives a wood-type revival the context it was born in

labels.look: Black then white chapters: concept prose, huge 'design' with weight/optical sliders over A–Z with advance widths, then square/circle/triangle turning into H O A
labels.ux: Weight and optical-size sliders on the alphabet; scroll steps through chapters (design, anatomy…)
labels.learn: Morph square, circle and triangle into H, O, A to show a geometric sans literally grows from primitives

labels.look: White, purple and orange lines in different styles, each tagged with a tiny style-name pill; cut continues into an axes box and a styles list
labels.ux: Intro static; below, a box with Flaire, Weight and Italic sliders on its edges that animate
labels.learn: Tag each intro line with the style it is set in: the pitch quietly becomes a style guide

labels.look: Open-book spread on light grey: blank left page, centred serif title on the right with an outlined ampersand
labels.ux: static; the site pages like a book (next spreads hold sliders)
labels.learn: Staging the whole site as book spreads makes a text serif feel at home and paces content page by page

labels.look: Grey title bar 'Second power', white cells with dotted pixel-block glyphs, a few extra-script glyphs tinted red and blue
labels.learn: Tint the glyphs of other scripts or blocks so coverage reads at a glance inside a uniform grid

labels.look: Saturated yellow, dark 3D lowercase 'd' inside blue gyroscope rings, translucent nav bar over it
labels.ux: Canvas animation; 'Rotate the 3D letter' control spins the d
labels.learn: Spinning a 3D 'd' shows how b, d, p and q swap places: the problem the font solves, without words

labels.variantDefinition: Tabs switch between realistic content samples for different use cases (languages, data, file listings), each a full-width panel set in the font
labels.look: Black panel, large green mono code ('@tick.tock! func Go(…'), five tabs above: Generic, SQL, Haskell, Files, Finance
labels.ux: Tabs swap SVG code samples; not editable
labels.learn: Let the buyer pick their own context (SQL, Haskell, finance tables) instead of one generic code sample

labels.look: Lime green band, 'Small Caps' title left, condensed 'Aa Bb Cc Dd' turning to 'AA BB CC DD' right
labels.ux: Looping GIF of the feature switching; static otherwise
labels.learn: A looping GIF of off→on is the cheapest possible feature demo and still reads instantly

labels.look: Colour bands (yellow, white, pink), each labelled with a style, caps / lowercase / figures alternating roman and italic, cropped at the right; quote tail on top
labels.ux: static; sticky pill bar (buy, PDF, trial, variable)
labels.learn: Alternate roman and italic letter by letter so each band compares the pair in one line
